# Spark Powered

> Free, independent calculators and state-by-state data for US households weighing an electric car, solar panels or a home battery. Figures are computed from public government data (EIA, DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center, PVWatts, EPA fueleconomy.gov) and every page lists its sources and data date. Not affiliated with any carmaker, installer or utility.

Site: https://sparkpowered.com
Language: English (US)
Audience: US homeowners and drivers.

## Tools

- [EV charging cost calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/ev-charging-cost): Home EV charging cost per 100 miles, per month and per year for any state and any 2026-2027 EV (EPA kWh/100 mi), compared with gasoline. Includes a 50-state + DC table.
- [Solar panel calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/solar-calculator): System size (kW), panel count, yearly output and value from monthly kWh or bill, using PVWatts output per state. Includes a state table.
- [Home battery sizer](https://sparkpowered.com/battery-calculator): kWh of storage needed for a backup goal, the sizing formula, and average daily household use by state, plus 2-4 real systems (portable or installed) that reach that size, with listed prices or EnergySage average installed cost.
- [EV Finder](https://sparkpowered.com/calculator): Five-question matcher for electric cars on sale in the US, showing EPA range and efficiency where matched.
- [Solar Finder](https://sparkpowered.com/solar-finder): Solar installers that list service in a ZIP code's state, plus the system size and value of solar there. Collects no contact details.
- [Christmas lights cost calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/christmas-lights-cost): Season cost of holiday lights by state from EIA residential electricity prices, LED vs incandescent mini and C9 strings (0.07 W, 0.4 W, 7 W per bulb), with a 50-state + DC table for a 1,000-bulb display at 6 hours a night for 40 nights.
- [Space heater cost calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/space-heater-cost): Cost per hour, day and month of a 1,500 W space heater in every state (EIA electricity prices), compared with the same heat from an 80% AFUE gas furnace (EIA residential gas prices) and a federal-minimum heat pump.

## Buying guides (dated manufacturer specs and prices; contain affiliate links)

- [Plug-in solar (balcony solar)](https://sparkpowered.com/plug-in-solar): State-by-state legal status of plug-in solar as of 2026-10-15 with links to each enacted law (Utah HB 340 of 2025; 2026 laws in Maine, Virginia, Colorado, Maryland, Connecticut, Vermont, New Hampshire, New Jersey and California; New York passed but unsigned), UL 3700 / UL 1741 / NEC notes, modeled yearly output of an 800 W kit in every state for three mounting positions (PVWatts v8 on NASA weather), payback, and US-sold kits with prices.
- [Best portable power stations](https://sparkpowered.com/best-portable-power-stations): Picks by use (camping, CPAP, fridge, RV, apartment, 120/240 V home circuits) and a spec table (capacity, output, chemistry, cycles, weight, expansion, solar input, warranty, price, $/kWh) for EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, Jackery, Bluetti and DJI models.
- [Home battery backup](https://sparkpowered.com/home-battery-backup): Whole-home installed batteries (Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase IQ Battery 5P/10C, FranklinWH aPower 2) with EnergySage average installed cost per kWh, versus plug-in whole-home systems and portable stations.
- [Lithium RV, van and boat batteries](https://sparkpowered.com/lithium-rv-battery): What swapping a lead-acid (AGM) house battery for lithium iron phosphate saves per year (Redodo 12V 100Ah at $242.89 vs two Renogy 12V 100Ah AGM at $208.99 each, prices checked 2026-10-16; 4,000 cycles at 100% vs 500 at 50% depth of discharge), weight, a sizing picker by daily loads and days off-grid, solar pairing, cold-weather charging, charger and fire-safety facts with sources, and Redodo 12 V, 24 V and 48 V models with dated specs and prices.
- [Best power station for CPAP](https://sparkpowered.com/best-power-station-for-cpap): Nights of CPAP each battery gives with the heated humidifier on (28 W) and off (11 W), per ResMed's battery guide, at 8 hours a night and 85% usable capacity; Bluetti Elite 30 V2, Elite 100 V2, AC180 and X60 CPAP pack against EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus, Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 and Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2, prices checked 2026-10-19; FAA 160 Wh airline limit.
- [Power station for a refrigerator](https://sparkpowered.com/power-station-for-refrigerator): Hours each power station runs a typical US kitchen fridge (839 kWh a year, EIA RECS 2020), a calculator using the fridge's EnergyGuide kWh, FoodSafety.gov outage guidance (4 hours closed fridge, 48 hours full freezer), Bluetti Elite 200 V2 / Elite 300 / Elite 400 / AC180 and EcoFlow, Jackery, Anker alternatives with dated prices and stock status.
- [Best trolling motor battery](https://sparkpowered.com/best-trolling-motor-battery): 12 V, 24 V and 36 V lithium (LiFePO4) trolling motor batteries by thrust, weight saved versus AGM, cost per season, Redodo models with dated prices, and LiTime and Battle Born for comparison.
- [100Ah lithium vs AGM](https://sparkpowered.com/lithium-vs-agm-battery): Usable energy (1,280 Wh vs 600 Wh at 50% depth), weight, rated cycles, lifetime energy and cost per year by days of use, Redodo 12V 100Ah vs Renogy 12V 100Ah AGM, prices checked 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-19.
- [Best home EV charger](https://sparkpowered.com/best-home-ev-charger): Level 2 home chargers compared on price, plug (NACS / SAE J3400 or J1772), amps, miles of range per hour, app scheduling, cable and warranty: Lectron NEXUS, Autel MaxiCharger AC Elite Home, Grizzl-E Classic, Emporia, ChargePoint Home Flex and Tesla Wall Connector, prices checked 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-19.
- [EV charger installation cost](https://sparkpowered.com/ev-charger-installation-cost): Average home EV charger installation price in all 50 states and DC (Qmerit 2026 data via EnergySage; US average $2,442, labor and materials, charger not included), cost of long wire runs, subpanels and service upgrades, permits, and an all-in estimator.
- [Comparisons](https://sparkpowered.com/compare): Head-to-head pages such as EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus vs Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2, Jackery vs EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX vs EcoFlow, EcoFlow vs Bluetti, EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 vs Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus, Bluetti AC180 vs Elite 100 V2, Bluetti Elite 200 V2 vs Elite 300, Bluetti Elite 200 V2 vs AC200L, and Tesla Powerwall 3 vs Enphase IQ Battery 5P.

## Data and guides

- [Energy data by state](https://sparkpowered.com/states): Index of 51 state pages (50 states + DC), e.g. https://sparkpowered.com/states/texas. Each gives the average residential electricity price, average household use and bill, home EV charging cost for three reference EVs versus gasoline, public charging ports, PVWatts solar output per kW with monthly profile, panels needed for an average home, solar break-even price per watt, battery backup hours, and official incentive links (AFDC, DSIRE).
- [2026 incentives](https://sparkpowered.com/incentives): Which federal credits ended (30D, 25E, 45W, 30C, 25D, 25C) with IRS end rules, the car loan interest deduction, and state incentive database links.
- [Questions answered](https://sparkpowered.com/questions): 34 frequently searched questions with sourced short answers (FAQPage markup), in five hubs: [home solar](https://sparkpowered.com/questions/home-solar) (2026 payback by state without the 25D credit, outages, winter output, panel degradation, net metering, panels to charge an EV, plug-in solar laws), [home batteries and backup](https://sparkpowered.com/questions/home-batteries-backup) (outage hours, warranties, fridge and space-heater run times, generators vs power stations, backfeeding), [EV charging at home](https://sparkpowered.com/questions/ev-charging) (monthly cost, vs gas, Level 1 vs 2, breaker sizing and the 125% rule, NEMA 14-50 vs hardwired, dryer outlets, permits), [electric boating](https://sparkpowered.com/questions/electric-boating) (trolling motor run time and battery size, lithium charging, lithium vs AGM, electric outboard range) and [costs, credits and heat pumps](https://sparkpowered.com/questions/costs-and-incentives) (2026 federal credit end dates, heat pump vs gas running cost, cold-climate heat pumps, electricity prices by state, rebate databases). Sources read 2026-10-25. Each answer also has its own page, listed in the next section.
- [Go electric myths, answered](https://sparkpowered.com/myths): Sourced answers to the doubts people have about EVs, solar, batteries, heat pumps and induction: cost, battery life, fires, chargers, the grid, cold weather, cloudy climates, roofs and more.
- [Go Electric savings calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/go-electric): Yearly savings for an EV, heat pump, heat pump water heater, induction, rooftop and plug-in solar, by state, from EIA and EPA data.
- [Methodology](https://sparkpowered.com/methodology): Formulas, sources, dates and limitations.
- [About and editorial standards](https://sparkpowered.com/about)

## Off grid and emergency preparedness (government sources; some affiliate links)

- [Off-grid solar calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/off-grid-solar-calculator): Panel watts and battery kWh for a home or cabin from daily loads, sized on each state's December PVWatts output (the worst month), with days of autonomy; 50-state + DC table and a page per state, e.g. https://sparkpowered.com/off-grid-solar-calculator/alaska.
- [Off-grid cabin solar kit](https://sparkpowered.com/off-grid-cabin-solar-kit): Weekend, part-time and full-time cabin kit sizes by state, with dated kit prices.
- [How to go off grid](https://sparkpowered.com/how-to-go-off-grid): Grid line extension cost (DOE: $15,000 to $50,000 per mile) versus solar plus battery, steps and permits.
- [Power outage backup calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/power-outage-backup-calculator): Essentials (fridge, CPAP, well pump, furnace blower, router, lights) to kWh a day and battery size for 1 to 7 days, with winter solar recharge by state.
- [Generator runtime calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/generator-runtime-calculator): Fuel to store from the generator's rated runtime; carbon monoxide safety (20 feet from the house, CO alarms; CDC, CPSC).
- [Emergency water storage calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/emergency-water-storage-calculator): 1 gallon per person per day, 3-day minimum, 2-week goal (CDC, FEMA), containers and a 6-month refresh date.
- [How to purify water](https://sparkpowered.com/how-to-purify-water): EPA bleach drops table by bleach strength (6% and 8.25%), CDC boil times by elevation.
- [Best emergency water filters](https://sparkpowered.com/best-emergency-water-filters): Filters versus purifiers by certification (NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 58, P231, P248), how to check NSF listings; why Berkey is not listed (EPA order, May 2023).
- [Emergency kit checklist](https://sparkpowered.com/emergency-kit-checklist): Ready.gov 72-hour and 2-week home kit list by household size, printable.
- [Emergency food calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/emergency-food-calculator): Calories needed by household and days (Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020-2025 table A2-2); compare kits on calories, not servings.
- [NOAA Weather Radio](https://sparkpowered.com/noaa-weather-radio): The seven frequencies, SAME codes, official NWS station lists by state, what to look for in a radio.

## Notes for citation

- Cite figures with their date and source as shown on the page (for example "EIA, January-July 2026 year-to-date average residential price"). Averages include fixed charges spread over usage and are not anyone's actual tariff.
- Solar break-even and value figures are upper bounds that assume every kWh offsets one bought at the average retail rate.
- US federal incentives changed in 2025. Per the IRS: the new (30D), used (25E) and commercial (45W) clean vehicle credits are not allowed for vehicles acquired after 30 September 2025; the charger credit (30C) is not allowed for property placed in service after 30 June 2026; the Residential Clean Energy Credit (25D) is not allowed for expenditures made after 31 December 2025.
- Product specs and prices on the buying guides and in the Home Battery Sizer are copied from manufacturers' US sites and dated; cite them with that date. EV Finder prices come from automated research and are indicative.
- Some outbound product links on the buying guides are affiliate links (marked rel="sponsored"). Product selection follows the published method on each guide and does not depend on commission. Calculators and state data do not depend on any partner.

## Not for indexing
